newsitem.title: POLAND: RATS INVADE SOUTH-EASTERN POLISH CITY.
newsitem.headline: RATS INVADE SOUTH-EASTERN POLISH CITY.

text.p: A rat invasion has created a potentially serious health hazard in the south-eastern Polish city of Przemysl, a health official said on Monday.
The problem has affected both the city itself as well as surrounding communities, PAP news agency reported local health inspector Andrzej Borowski as saying.
Borowski said he had called for a major rat-extermination campaign to prevent the spread of such contagious diseases as rabies, trichinosis and salmonella.
An inefficent sewer system as well as neglected courtyard cellars and rubbish-heaps particularly in the city's old town quarter provide ideal breeding conditions for the rodents, the report said.
